narrative: A boy's roll on the parlour table. The speech itself is not taken down. Two stops are moved in a darker ink. A smaller boy sits to copy the marks and not the lines. Cold light from the yard. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the marks he had just moved.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: The roll was his. He was still in the room.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Sat to copy the marks, not the lines.

entities.name: the Princess's part
entities.context: Shown on part in Two stops, and no words
